1. PRESENT SITUATION:

2. PROPOSED SOLUTION:

3. SCOPE OF WORK:

    3.1 BUSINESS PARTNER (BP) shall strictly follow all relevant TCO Safety Instructions.

    3.2 BUSINESS PARTNER (BP) shall follow all Quality Management (QM) requirements designated in the Quality Control package.

4. PRELIMINARY SITE WORK (PSW):

    4.1 Prior to commencing any fabrication works verify dimensions, pipe routing and field weld locations on site.

5. SHOP WORK:

    5.1 Withdraw materials required for this Job Pack from TCO Warehouse according to Material Request(s).

    5.2 Perform Positive Material Identification (PMI) as per TCO RE QM SWP-20 Procedure on all corrosion resistant alloy (CRA) materials and weld consumables.

    5.3 Prefabricate pipe spools as per isometric drawing(s) 00-YYYY-L-ZZZZ. Use TCO-approved Welding Procedure Specification(s) (WPSs) indicated on isometric drawing(s). BP shall comply with TCO Guideline 16-0015-MI for socket-welded joints.

    5.4 Perform non-destructive examination (NDE) as specified on drawing 00-YYYY-L-ZZZZ. NOTE: BP must check with MaxTrax admin on NDE requirements prior to commence welding works.

6. SITE WORK:

    6.1 Perform relevant job safety assessments (PPHA & JSA) and obtain required Permits-to-Work (PTWs).

    6.2 Demarcate work area as necessary and erect scaffolding for access.

    NOTE: TCO Operations shall isolate, depressurize, drain and ready for Hot Work, Equipment and Piping associated with this Project, if and as applicable, and shall hand it over to BUSINESS PARTNER (BP); fully accessible, safe and Locked-Out-Tagged-Out (LOTO) as scheduled and agreed between TCO Operations and BP.

    6.3 Remove all cladding and insulation to the extent required.

    6.4 Perform PMI at field joints per TCO RE QM SWP-20 on alloy materials listed in SWP-20 Appendix 20-1.

    6.5 All QM piping passport documentation (A-category Checklists) to be verified and signed by TCO-approved QM Inspector prior to PSSR, but not later than 24 hours after mechanical scope completion.

    6.6 Advise xxxxx yyyyy/ zzzzz mmmm, DTEC KTL Plant Support / DTEC T/A / SGP/SGI / FUPO Engineer at ext. 0000 about work completion and invite all necessary people to PSSR.

    6.7 Job Pack Coordinator shall submit the completed PIC check-list to Operations department after being signed by Quality Management group. (Form is provided by QM Dept.).

    6.8 Conduct PSSR and close out A-category punch points.

    6.9 Following PSSR reinstate / install insulation and cladding, as per TES IRM-SU-1381-TCO and as specified on isometric drawing 00-YYYY-L-ZZZZ.

    6.10 Close out all B-category punch points and remove associated scaffolding.

    6.11 Clean up the work area and demobilize from site.

7. AFTER COMPLETION OF WORK:

    7.1 Final as-built package (including B-category Checklist) submitted to TCO QM group within 2 weeks.

    7.2 Return excess material to TCO Warehouse.
